summary: Describes mechanisms that improve SigComp compression efficiency compared with compressing each message on its own, such as using state saved from earlier messages. They are built using the instructions of the SigComp Universal Decompressor Virtual Machine. It was later updated by RFC 4896.

eli5.summary: If you already told a friend a long story, next time you only share what changed. These extras let SigComp remember earlier messages so later ones can be much smaller.
